gates.name: Price proves the level
gates.detail: Need 3 consecutive (2022's fakeout died at 2), then a weekly close over the $84.5k supply shelf that holds. Shelf close: no; holding now: no. Weekly close < $72k kills it.

gates.name: Demand replaces the squeeze
gates.detail: Need 3 straight completed weeks >= $1,000M (now 1) AND 14d funding under 5% ann. while price holds (spot-led, not re-levered). CryptoQuant spot+futures demand staying positive through late Sep is the manual third check — no free feed. Funding spiking with price flat kills it.

gates.name: Time runs out on the bears
gates.detail: The Q4-flush thesis is a WINDOW (early-mid Oct cluster), not just a target. A flush needs momentum to feed on; every week above the 50W EMA subtracts one from the bears. Above the line at the deadline = no mechanism left.
